title: Wearing Masks Implies Refuting Trump?: Towards Target-specific User Stance Prediction across Events in COVID-19 and US Election 2020
reasoning: The paper focuses on stance detection in social media regarding political and social topics such as COVID-19 masks, racial equality, and Donald Trump.
